Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in the very first step by hallucinating a specific release year for "New Jersey Drive" (1995) in the instructions given to the WebSurfer ("Search for the release year... for: 1) New Jersey Drive (1995)..."). The task was to *find* the release years, not to assume them. While the WebSurfer later confirmed the year was 1995, the Planner's initial instruction contained an unjustified assumption that violated the instruction to "Gather information systematically." This premature assumption set a flawed premise for the search, even though the subsequent search results happened to align with the hallucinated number. The Planner failed to follow the core directive of gathering unknown data by inserting a specific fact into the search parameters before verification.
